mia_sunk_cost.definition: Money, time or effort that has already been spent, and which is used as a reason to continue.
mia_sunk_cost.example: The sunk cost of the training was the argument for staying in the job.

mon_legal_tender.definition: The money the law accepts as the final payment of a debt, so that no one can refuse it as the wrong money.
mon_legal_tender.example: The landlord must take legal tender for the rent, even when he prefers a transfer.

pupa.definition: The resting stage, when the insect changes its body. A butterfly's pupa is a chrysalis.
pupa.example: Inside the pupa, the caterpillar becomes a butterfly.

transit_area.definition: The secure part of the airport where you wait for a connecting flight. You cannot leave it without a new ticket.
transit_area.example: My flight is delayed, so I am stuck in the transit area.
